title: Regression coverage audit for reproduced A02/A03/A04 failures
workingTree: Pre-existing dirty source/tests were preserved. This step added no application or test code because direct behavior tests already cover each reproduced A02/A03/A04 failure.

testRun.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --reporter=dot src/dev/mocks/auth-handlers.test.ts src/features/auth/api/auth-api.test.ts src/features/auth/api/auth-openapi-contract.test.ts src/app/contexts/AuthSessionProvider.test.tsx src/shared/session/auth-context.test.ts src/shared/api/http-client.test.ts src/shared/api/query-client.test.ts src/features/market/model/market-queries.test.tsx src/features/wallet/api/wallet-api.test.ts
testRun.environment: Windows 11 Pro; Node.js v24.19.0; Vitest 4.1.11; local adapters/fake fetch/MSW; no backend or staging connection

regressionMap.originalFailure: The baseline login envelope was rejected with Zod invalid_union at status, and no /auth/login/mfa/verify handler was registered (EV-20260927-006).
regressionMap.behaviorUnderTest: The MSW login handler returns the contract discriminated union; the real auth adapter accepts authenticated and mfa_required shapes; verification requires the backend challenge ID/code and does not authenticate before success.

regressionMap.originalFailure: A deferred refresh resolving after remote logout restored authenticated=true and a stale access token; the original test failed before the fix (EV-20260927-015).
regressionMap.behaviorUnderTest: A response from an older auth operation cannot restore local session/token after remote logout. Neighboring tests also cover stale bootstrap/login/MFA success and refresh error, a later login winning, and loginSync winning over an older refresh.

regressionMap.originalFailure: Pre-aborted requests still called fetch; abort during retry backoff was not surfaced as REQUEST_ABORTED; explicit retry counts were unbounded (EV-20260927-026, EV-20260927-028, EV-20260927-031).
regressionMap.behaviorUnderTest: The shared client does not dispatch a pre-aborted request, uses one total timeout budget, caps/validates retries, keeps correlation/idempotency headers stable, never retries an ambiguous POST by default, handles abort during unauthorized handling/backoff and cleans up the deferred request. The market query integration propagates observer unmount cancellation through the API/client to fetch.

decision.reason: Each baseline-reproduced behavior is already asserted at its owning MSW/API/provider/HTTP/query boundary, including historical red-before-fix evidence. A duplicate test would add no independent failure signal.
unresolved: The full suite mismatch recorded by C03.01 remains: WebLoginPage.test.tsx expects old transport-error copy while the current dirty source returns new copy. Product intent is not established in this step; carry it to C03.05 rather than changing the behavior or weakening the assertion.
Current tests prove frontend behavior only. They do not certify backend MFA policy, server session revocation, provider replay semantics, or real API behavior.
